title: ChatHealthy Provider Input (NPPES Dissemination Row)
description: Provider data AS RECEIVED, before any ChatHealthy transformation. The source is the CMS National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES) Data Dissemination bundle, version 2 of the layout, as documented in the NPPES Data Dissemination Readme (Exhibit 2-1 Data File Layout, document updated May 12, 2026, held at _oneshots/nppes_NPPES_Data_Dissemination_Readme_v.2.pdf). The root object is one row of the main data file (one enumerated NPI record). $defs/practice_location_reference_row describes one row of the Practice Location Reference File (Exhibit 2-3), the second provider file from the same bundle that this pipeline ingests, which carries every non-primary practice location. This schema describes the INPUT only. It is not the runtime provider record: ChatHealthyProvidersSchema.json and ProviderRecordSchema.json describe what the pipeline produces, which is a different shape with snake_cased keys, collapsed arrays and pipeline-derived enrichment, and an input row will not validate against either. Where the row enters ChatHealthy: pipeline/Code/staging_loader.py, function _load_one_source, which streams the file through _iter_csv_rows / _iter_zipped_csv_rows (csv.DictReader, which preserves column names verbatim) and stores each row untouched under the staging document's raw subdocument via _wrap_row. Every value is a string because the file is CSV: NPPES quotes every value, so numbers, codes and dates all arrive as text and the pipeline stores the text unchanged. Where Exhibit 2-1 declares a logical NUMBER or DATE type, the field description says so. Absence versus emptiness: csv.DictReader yields every declared column as a key on every row, so a column the source has no value for arrives as the empty string rather than missing. Only NPI is listed in required, because only the record key can be established as always carrying a value; the ingest code guards every other column for emptiness, including Entity Type Code, which pipeline/Code/provider_record_builder.py line 74 tolerates being blank. additionalProperties is false because Exhibit 2-1 states it lists the column headers in the order present in the data file, so it is exhaustive for this layout version; a column outside it means CMS has changed the layout, and the catch-all in normalize_provider_rows.py lines 257-270 would silently carry it onto the provider record.

NPI.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier. Readme Exhibit 2-1 declares max length 10, data type NUMBER; the CSV supplies it as text.
